current.text: Beal will miss the start of the season while he recovers from a hip fracture and has knee soreness.
He re-signed with the Clippers after hip surgery.
He is not in the projected starting lineup. He is projected as the seventh man off the bench, behind Kris Dunn.
The expert thinks Beal is probably washed. He sees some upside because the Clippers need shot creation.
He could be a streaming option at times if he gets up to 30 minutes.
The Clippers expect a trial season with long rotations and many players tested. Coach Ty Lue also tends to make odd rotation choices and then change them.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule (4-3-4 games for a March 28 end). They also have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league, with 13.

durable.text: Knee soreness has been a long-running problem for Beal. He has also had hip surgery after a hip fracture.

note: Beal is not a draft target. Yahoo and ESPN both give him 0 USD value, he ranks 239 and 246, he went for only 3 USD in our last auction, and the expert says do not draft. He is out to start the season with a hip and knee problem and is projected as a bench player, so leave him on waivers.
